\section{Stand Metrics}
\label{sec:metrics}

As mapped in Figure~\ref{fig:creek}, the buffer narrows to under
15~m at reaches R4 and R7, and both reaches lost planted stems
at roughly twice the corridor-wide rate.

The ordination in the appendix follows the reach grouping of
Figure~\ref{fig:crek}, pooling sites by valley-floor width
rather than by aspect. Alder dominance tracks the narrow
reaches, while cedar recovery concentrates on the wide,
well-drained benches.

Canopy closure explains most of the variance in understorey
cover; the densiometer series is archived with the reach maps.
